```{r}
# ==============================================================
# GENUS-LEVEL ENTEROCOCCUS dPCR GLMM
# RAW COPIES PER GRAM
# HOUSE RETAINED + HOUSE ICC
#
# Distribution:
#   Lognormal = natural-log response + Gaussian model
#
# GLOBAL MODEL:
#   log(copies_per_gram) ~
#     Treatment * Growout + Position + (1 | House)
#
# GROWOUT-SPECIFIC MODELS:
#   log(copies_per_gram) ~
#     Treatment + Position + (1 | House)
#
# House is ALWAYS retained because House is the experimental unit.
#
# Treatment contrasts within Growout are obtained from the
# GLOBAL model using emmeans, consistent with the manuscript.
#
# Growout-specific models are used for omnibus Treatment and
# Position tests, consistent with the original analysis structure.
#
# DHARMa diagnostics are run on the GLOBAL model only, consistent
# with the original model-assessment workflow.
#
# Output includes:
#   - Global Type III Wald tests
#   - Global Treatment contrast
#   - Treatment contrasts within each Growout
#   - Growout-specific Type III Treatment and Position tests
#   - Global and growout-specific House variance and SD
#   - Global and growout-specific adjusted/unadjusted ICC
#   - Global DHARMa diagnostics
#
# Saves:
#   ONE Excel workbook
#   ONE worksheet
#   ONE flat results table
# ==============================================================


# ==============================================================
# 0. Packages
# ==============================================================

library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(dplyr)
library(performance)
library(writexl)


# ==============================================================
# 1. Check required columns
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_icc_required <- c(
  "Growout",
  "Treatment",
  "House",
  "Position",
  "copies_per_gram"
)

entero_genus_icc_missing <- setdiff(
  entero_genus_icc_required,
  names(entero.merged)
)

if (length(entero_genus_icc_missing) > 0) {
  stop(
    "entero.merged is missing required columns: ",
    paste(
      entero_genus_icc_missing,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 2. Prepare data
#
# Original entero.merged is NOT modified.
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_icc_df <- entero.merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Growout = factor(Growout),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment),
    House = factor(House),
    Position = factor(Position),
    log_copies_raw = log(copies_per_gram)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(log_copies_raw)
  ) %>%
  droplevels()


cat(
  "Genus-level samples included:",
  nrow(entero_genus_icc_df),
  "\n"
)


# ==============================================================
# 3. Type III contrast settings
# ==============================================================

old_contr_genus_icc <- options(
  contrasts = c(
    "contr.sum",
    "contr.poly"
  )
)


# ==============================================================
# 4. Helper: House variance + ICC
#
# tolerance = 0 permits reporting of very small House variance.
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_icc_house_stats <- function(model) {

  vc <- glmmTMB::VarCorr(model)$cond

  house_variance <- as.numeric(
    vc$House[1, 1]
  )

  house_sd <- sqrt(
    house_variance
  )


  icc_result <- suppressWarnings(
    tryCatch(
      performance::icc(
        model,
        tolerance = 0
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  )


  if (is.null(icc_result)) {

    icc_adjusted <- NA_real_
    icc_unadjusted <- NA_real_

  } else {

    icc_adjusted <- as.numeric(
      icc_result$ICC_adjusted[1]
    )

    icc_unadjusted <- as.numeric(
      icc_result$ICC_unadjusted[1]
    )
  }


  data.frame(
    Variance = house_variance,
    SD = house_sd,
    ICC_adjusted = icc_adjusted,
    ICC_unadjusted = icc_unadjusted,
    Percent_House_adjusted =
      icc_adjusted * 100,
    Percent_House_unadjusted =
      icc_unadjusted * 100
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 5. Helper: emmeans test statistic
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_icc_get_stat <- function(df) {

  if ("z.ratio" %in% names(df)) {
    return(
      as.numeric(df$z.ratio)
    )
  }

  if ("t.ratio" %in% names(df)) {
    return(
      as.numeric(df$t.ratio)
    )
  }

  rep(
    NA_real_,
    nrow(df)
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 6. GLOBAL model
#
# House is retained regardless of estimated variance.
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_icc_model <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
  log_copies_raw ~
    Treatment * Growout +
    Position +
    (1 | House),
  family = gaussian(
    link = "identity"
  ),
  data = entero_genus_icc_df
)


# ==============================================================
# 7. GLOBAL Type III Wald tests
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_icc_anova <- car::Anova(
  entero_genus_icc_model,
  type = 3
)


cat(
  "\n==============================================\n",
  "GLOBAL TYPE III WALD TESTS\n",
  "==============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  entero_genus_icc_anova
)


# ==============================================================
# 8. GLOBAL Treatment contrast
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_icc_global_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
  entero_genus_icc_model,
  ~ Treatment
)

entero_genus_icc_global_pairs <- emmeans::contrast(
  entero_genus_icc_global_emm,
  method = "pairwise",
  adjust = "BH"
)

entero_genus_icc_global_df <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    entero_genus_icc_global_pairs
  )
)


cat(
  "\n==============================================\n",
  "GLOBAL TREATMENT CONTRAST\n",
  "==============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  entero_genus_icc_global_df
)


# ==============================================================
# 9. Treatment contrasts within Growout
#
# IMPORTANT:
# These come from the GLOBAL model, consistent with the
# manuscript Methods and original analysis.
#
# This object name is retained for downstream plotting:
#   entero_genus_icc_pergo_df
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_icc_pergo_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
  entero_genus_icc_model,
  ~ Treatment | Growout
)

entero_genus_icc_pergo_pairs <- emmeans::contrast(
  entero_genus_icc_pergo_emm,
  method = "pairwise",
  adjust = "BH"
)

entero_genus_icc_pergo_df <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    entero_genus_icc_pergo_pairs
  )
)


cat(
  "\n==============================================\n",
  "TREATMENT CONTRASTS WITHIN GROWOUT\n",
  "FROM GLOBAL MODEL\n",
  "==============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  entero_genus_icc_pergo_df
)


# ==============================================================
# 10. GLOBAL House variance + ICC
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_icc_global_house <-
  entero_genus_icc_house_stats(
    entero_genus_icc_model
  )


cat(
  "\n==============================================\n",
  "GLOBAL HOUSE VARIANCE AND ICC\n",
  "==============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  entero_genus_icc_global_house
)


# ==============================================================
# 11. GLOBAL DHARMa diagnostics
#
# Diagnostics remain on the primary global model only.
# ==============================================================

set.seed(5080)

entero_genus_icc_dharma <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = entero_genus_icc_model,
  n = 1000
)

entero_genus_icc_dispersion <- DHARMa::testDispersion(
  entero_genus_icc_dharma
)

entero_genus_icc_outliers <- DHARMa::testOutliers(
  entero_genus_icc_dharma
)

entero_genus_icc_quantiles <- DHARMa::testQuantiles(
  entero_genus_icc_dharma
)


cat(
  "\n==============================================\n",
  "GLOBAL DHARMa DIAGNOSTICS\n",
  "==============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "Dispersion p =",
  entero_genus_icc_dispersion$p.value,
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Outliers p =",
  entero_genus_icc_outliers$p.value,
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Quantiles p =",
  entero_genus_icc_quantiles$p.value,
  "\n"
)


# ==============================================================
# 12. Fit GROWOUT-SPECIFIC models
#
# Same structure used in the original manuscript-reporting code:
#
#   log_copies_raw ~ Treatment + Position + (1 | House)
#
# Difference from original:
#   House is NEVER dropped.
#
# These models are used for growout-specific omnibus
# Treatment and Position tests.
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_icc_pergo_models <- lapply(
  levels(entero_genus_icc_df$Growout),
  function(growout_value) {

    df_i <- entero_genus_icc_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        as.character(Growout) ==
          as.character(growout_value)
      ) %>%
      droplevels()


    model_i <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
      log_copies_raw ~
        Treatment +
        Position +
        (1 | House),
      family = gaussian(
        link = "identity"
      ),
      data = df_i
    )


    list(
      Growout =
        as.character(growout_value),

      N =
        stats::nobs(model_i),

      model =
        model_i,

      anova =
        car::Anova(
          model_i,
          type = 3
        ),

      house =
        entero_genus_icc_house_stats(
          model_i
        )
    )
  }
)

names(entero_genus_icc_pergo_models) <-
  levels(entero_genus_icc_df$Growout)


# ==============================================================
# 13. Print GROWOUT-SPECIFIC Type III tests + House ICC
# ==============================================================

cat(
  "\n==============================================\n",
  "GROWOUT-SPECIFIC MODELS\n",
  "==============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)


for (
  growout_value in names(
    entero_genus_icc_pergo_models
  )
) {

  one <- getElement(
    entero_genus_icc_pergo_models,
    growout_value
  )

  cat(
    "\n----------------------------------------------\n",
    "Growout ",
    growout_value,
    "\n",
    "----------------------------------------------\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  print(
    one$anova
  )

  cat(
    "\nHouse variance / ICC:\n"
  )

  print(
    one$house
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 14. Build ONE flat results table
#
# Keeps the global workspace relatively clean.
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_icc_build_results <- function() {

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # A. Global Type III fixed effects
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  anova_global <- as.data.frame(
    entero_genus_icc_anova
  )

  anova_global$Effect <- rownames(
    anova_global
  )

  rownames(anova_global) <- NULL

  anova_global <- anova_global[
    anova_global$Effect != "(Intercept)",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  rows_global_fixed <- data.frame(
    Analysis = "Global",
    Metric = "Enterococcus genus",
    Growout = "All",
    Family = "lognormal",
    Transform = "log",
    N = stats::nobs(
      entero_genus_icc_model
    ),
    Result_type =
      "Fixed effect - Type III Wald",
    Effect_or_contrast =
      as.character(
        anova_global$Effect
      ),
    Estimate = NA_real_,
    SE = NA_real_,
    df = as.numeric(
      anova_global[, "Df"]
    ),
    Test_statistic = as.numeric(
      anova_global[, "Chisq"]
    ),
    P_value = as.numeric(
      anova_global[, "Pr(>Chisq)"]
    ),
    Variance = NA_real_,
    SD = NA_real_,
    ICC_adjusted = NA_real_,
    ICC_unadjusted = NA_real_,
    Percent_House_adjusted = NA_real_,
    Percent_House_unadjusted = NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # B. Global Treatment contrast
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  global_stat <-
    entero_genus_icc_get_stat(
      entero_genus_icc_global_df
    )


  global_df_value <- if (
    "df" %in%
      names(entero_genus_icc_global_df)
  ) {

    as.numeric(
      entero_genus_icc_global_df$df
    )

  } else {

    rep(
      NA_real_,
      nrow(entero_genus_icc_global_df)
    )
  }


  rows_global_pair <- data.frame(
    Analysis = "Global",
    Metric = "Enterococcus genus",
    Growout = "All",
    Family = "lognormal",
    Transform = "log",
    N = stats::nobs(
      entero_genus_icc_model
    ),
    Result_type =
      "Treatment contrast - global emmeans",
    Effect_or_contrast =
      as.character(
        entero_genus_icc_global_df$contrast
      ),
    Estimate = as.numeric(
      entero_genus_icc_global_df$estimate
    ),
    SE = as.numeric(
      entero_genus_icc_global_df$SE
    ),
    df = global_df_value,
    Test_statistic = global_stat,
    P_value = as.numeric(
      entero_genus_icc_global_df$p.value
    ),
    Variance = NA_real_,
    SD = NA_real_,
    ICC_adjusted = NA_real_,
    ICC_unadjusted = NA_real_,
    Percent_House_adjusted = NA_real_,
    Percent_House_unadjusted = NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # C. Treatment contrasts within Growout
  #    FROM GLOBAL MODEL
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  pergo_stat <-
    entero_genus_icc_get_stat(
      entero_genus_icc_pergo_df
    )


  pergo_df_value <- if (
    "df" %in%
      names(entero_genus_icc_pergo_df)
  ) {

    as.numeric(
      entero_genus_icc_pergo_df$df
    )

  } else {

    rep(
      NA_real_,
      nrow(entero_genus_icc_pergo_df)
    )
  }


  rows_pergo_pairs <- data.frame(
    Analysis = "Within-growout",
    Metric = "Enterococcus genus",
    Growout = as.character(
      entero_genus_icc_pergo_df$Growout
    ),
    Family = "lognormal",
    Transform = "log",
    N = stats::nobs(
      entero_genus_icc_model
    ),
    Result_type =
      "Treatment contrast - emmeans",
    Effect_or_contrast =
      as.character(
        entero_genus_icc_pergo_df$contrast
      ),
    Estimate = as.numeric(
      entero_genus_icc_pergo_df$estimate
    ),
    SE = as.numeric(
      entero_genus_icc_pergo_df$SE
    ),
    df = pergo_df_value,
    Test_statistic = pergo_stat,
    P_value = as.numeric(
      entero_genus_icc_pergo_df$p.value
    ),
    Variance = NA_real_,
    SD = NA_real_,
    ICC_adjusted = NA_real_,
    ICC_unadjusted = NA_real_,
    Percent_House_adjusted = NA_real_,
    Percent_House_unadjusted = NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # D. Global House random effect
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  rows_global_house <- data.frame(
    Analysis = "Global",
    Metric = "Enterococcus genus",
    Growout = "All",
    Family = "lognormal",
    Transform = "log",
    N = stats::nobs(
      entero_genus_icc_model
    ),
    Result_type = "Random effect",
    Effect_or_contrast = "House",
    Estimate = NA_real_,
    SE = NA_real_,
    df = NA_real_,
    Test_statistic = NA_real_,
    P_value = NA_real_,
    Variance =
      entero_genus_icc_global_house$Variance,
    SD =
      entero_genus_icc_global_house$SD,
    ICC_adjusted =
      entero_genus_icc_global_house$ICC_adjusted,
    ICC_unadjusted =
      entero_genus_icc_global_house$ICC_unadjusted,
    Percent_House_adjusted =
      entero_genus_icc_global_house$Percent_House_adjusted,
    Percent_House_unadjusted =
      entero_genus_icc_global_house$Percent_House_unadjusted,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # E. Global DHARMa diagnostics
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  rows_dharma <- data.frame(
    Analysis = rep(
      "Global",
      3
    ),
    Metric = rep(
      "Enterococcus genus",
      3
    ),
    Growout = rep(
      "All",
      3
    ),
    Family = rep(
      "lognormal",
      3
    ),
    Transform = rep(
      "log",
      3
    ),
    N = rep(
      stats::nobs(
        entero_genus_icc_model
      ),
      3
    ),
    Result_type = rep(
      "DHARMa diagnostic",
      3
    ),
    Effect_or_contrast = c(
      "Dispersion",
      "Outliers",
      "Quantiles"
    ),
    Estimate = NA_real_,
    SE = NA_real_,
    df = NA_real_,
    Test_statistic = NA_real_,
    P_value = c(
      entero_genus_icc_dispersion$p.value,
      entero_genus_icc_outliers$p.value,
      entero_genus_icc_quantiles$p.value
    ),
    Variance = NA_real_,
    SD = NA_real_,
    ICC_adjusted = NA_real_,
    ICC_unadjusted = NA_real_,
    Percent_House_adjusted = NA_real_,
    Percent_House_unadjusted = NA_real_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # F. Growout-specific Type III + House rows
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  rows_pergo_models <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      names(
        entero_genus_icc_pergo_models
      ),
      function(growout_value) {

        one <- getElement(
          entero_genus_icc_pergo_models,
          growout_value
        )


        anova_i <- as.data.frame(
          one$anova
        )

        anova_i$Effect <- rownames(
          anova_i
        )

        rownames(anova_i) <- NULL

        anova_i <- anova_i[
          anova_i$Effect != "(Intercept)",
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]


        fixed_i <- data.frame(
          Analysis =
            "Growout-specific",
          Metric =
            "Enterococcus genus",
          Growout =
            growout_value,
          Family =
            "lognormal",
          Transform =
            "log",
          N =
            one$N,
          Result_type =
            "Fixed effect - Type III Wald",
          Effect_or_contrast =
            as.character(
              anova_i$Effect
            ),
          Estimate =
            NA_real_,
          SE =
            NA_real_,
          df =
            as.numeric(
              anova_i[, "Df"]
            ),
          Test_statistic =
            as.numeric(
              anova_i[, "Chisq"]
            ),
          P_value =
            as.numeric(
              anova_i[, "Pr(>Chisq)"]
            ),
          Variance =
            NA_real_,
          SD =
            NA_real_,
          ICC_adjusted =
            NA_real_,
          ICC_unadjusted =
            NA_real_,
          Percent_House_adjusted =
            NA_real_,
          Percent_House_unadjusted =
            NA_real_,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )


        house_i <- data.frame(
          Analysis =
            "Growout-specific",
          Metric =
            "Enterococcus genus",
          Growout =
            growout_value,
          Family =
            "lognormal",
          Transform =
            "log",
          N =
            one$N,
          Result_type =
            "Random effect",
          Effect_or_contrast =
            "House",
          Estimate =
            NA_real_,
          SE =
            NA_real_,
          df =
            NA_real_,
          Test_statistic =
            NA_real_,
          P_value =
            NA_real_,
          Variance =
            one$house$Variance,
          SD =
            one$house$SD,
          ICC_adjusted =
            one$house$ICC_adjusted,
          ICC_unadjusted =
            one$house$ICC_unadjusted,
          Percent_House_adjusted =
            one$house$Percent_House_adjusted,
          Percent_House_unadjusted =
            one$house$Percent_House_unadjusted,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )


        dplyr::bind_rows(
          fixed_i,
          house_i
        )
      }
    )
  )


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # G. Combine everything
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    rows_global_fixed,
    rows_global_pair,
    rows_global_house,
    rows_dharma,
    rows_pergo_models,
    rows_pergo_pairs
  ) %>%

    dplyr::mutate(

      Analysis_order =
        dplyr::case_when(
          Analysis == "Global" ~ 1,
          Analysis == "Growout-specific" ~ 2,
          Analysis == "Within-growout" ~ 3,
          TRUE ~ 4
        ),

      Growout_order =
        dplyr::case_when(
          Growout == "All" ~ 0,
          Growout == "1" ~ 1,
          Growout == "2" ~ 2,
          TRUE ~ 99
        ),

      Result_order =
        dplyr::case_when(
          Result_type ==
            "Fixed effect - Type III Wald" ~ 1,

          Result_type ==
            "Treatment contrast - global emmeans" ~ 2,

          Result_type ==
            "Treatment contrast - emmeans" ~ 3,

          Result_type ==
            "Random effect" ~ 4,

          Result_type ==
            "DHARMa diagnostic" ~ 5,

          TRUE ~ 99
        )
    ) %>%

    dplyr::arrange(
      Analysis_order,
      Growout_order,
      Result_order
    ) %>%

    dplyr::select(
      -Analysis_order,
      -Growout_order,
      -Result_order
    )
}


entero_genus_icc_results <-
  entero_genus_icc_build_results()


# ==============================================================
# 15. Print complete results
# ==============================================================

cat(
  "\n==============================================\n",
  "COMPLETE ENTEROCOCCUS GENUS dPCR RESULTS\n",
  "==============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  entero_genus_icc_results,
  n = Inf
)


# ==============================================================
# 16. Print key manuscript results
# ==============================================================

cat(
  "\n==============================================\n",
  "GLOBAL FIXED EFFECTS\n",
  "==============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  entero_genus_icc_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Analysis == "Global",
      Result_type ==
        "Fixed effect - Type III Wald"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Effect_or_contrast,
      Test_statistic,
      df,
      P_value
    ),
  n = Inf
)


cat(
  "\n==============================================\n",
  "GROWOUT-SPECIFIC FIXED EFFECTS\n",
  "==============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  entero_genus_icc_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Analysis == "Growout-specific",
      Result_type ==
        "Fixed effect - Type III Wald"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Growout,
      Effect_or_contrast,
      Test_statistic,
      df,
      P_value
    ),
  n = Inf
)


cat(
  "\n==============================================\n",
  "TREATMENT CONTRASTS WITHIN GROWOUT\n",
  "==============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  entero_genus_icc_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Analysis == "Within-growout",
      Result_type ==
        "Treatment contrast - emmeans"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Growout,
      Effect_or_contrast,
      Estimate,
      SE,
      Test_statistic,
      P_value
    ),
  n = Inf
)


cat(
  "\n==============================================\n",
  "HOUSE RANDOM-EFFECT VARIANCE AND ICC\n",
  "==============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  entero_genus_icc_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Result_type == "Random effect"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Analysis,
      Growout,
      Variance,
      SD,
      ICC_adjusted,
      ICC_unadjusted,
      Percent_House_adjusted,
      Percent_House_unadjusted
    ),
  n = Inf
)


# ==============================================================
# 17. Plot GLOBAL DHARMa diagnostics
# ==============================================================

plot(
  entero_genus_icc_dharma,
  main = "Enterococcus genus dPCR"
)


# ==============================================================
# 18. Save ONE flat results table to ONE Excel worksheet
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_icc_excel_file <-
  "Enterococcus Genus dPCR GLMM Summary - House Retained with ICC.xlsx"


writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    "dPCR GLMM Results" =
      entero_genus_icc_results
  ),
  path =
    entero_genus_icc_excel_file
)


# ==============================================================
# 19. Restore original contrast settings
# ==============================================================

options(
  old_contr_genus_icc
)


# ==============================================================
# 20. Confirm saved file
# ==============================================================

cat(
  "\nExcel file written to:\n",
  normalizePath(
    entero_genus_icc_excel_file,
    mustWork = FALSE
  ),
  "\n"
)

```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# SPECIES-LEVEL ENTEROCOCCUS dPCR GLMM
# RAW COPIES PER GRAM
# HOUSE RETAINED + HOUSE ICC
#
# Species:
#   Cecorum
#   Hirae
#
# Distribution:
#   Tweedie with log link first
#   Gamma with log link + 0.1 response adjustment if Tweedie fails
#
# GLOBAL MODEL:
#   copies ~ Treatment * Growout + Position + (1 | House)
#
# GROWOUT-SPECIFIC MODELS:
#   copies ~ Treatment + Position + (1 | House)
#
# House is ALWAYS retained because House is the experimental unit.
#
# Treatment contrasts within Growout are obtained from the
# GLOBAL model using emmeans, consistent with the manuscript.
#
# Growout-specific models are used for omnibus Treatment and
# Position tests, consistent with the original analysis structure.
#
# DHARMa diagnostics are run on the GLOBAL models only,
# consistent with the original model-assessment workflow.
#
# Output includes:
#   - Global Type III Wald tests
#   - Global Treatment contrasts
#   - Treatment contrasts within each Growout
#   - Growout-specific Type III Treatment and Position tests
#   - Global and growout-specific House variance and SD
#   - Global and growout-specific adjusted/unadjusted ICC
#   - Global DHARMa diagnostics
#
# Saves:
#   ONE Excel workbook
#   ONE worksheet
#   ONE flat results table
# ==============================================================


# ==============================================================
# 0. Packages
# ==============================================================

library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(dplyr)
library(performance)
library(writexl)


# ==============================================================
# 1. Check required columns
# ==============================================================

species_house_icc_required <- c(
  "Target..Name.",
  "Growout",
  "Treatment",
  "House",
  "Position",
  "copies_per_g_litter"
)

species_house_icc_missing <- setdiff(
  species_house_icc_required,
  names(entero_species_merged)
)

if (length(species_house_icc_missing) > 0) {

  stop(
    "entero_species_merged is missing required columns: ",
    paste(
      species_house_icc_missing,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 2. Type III contrast settings
# ==============================================================

old_contr_species_house_icc <- options(
  contrasts = c(
    "contr.sum",
    "contr.poly"
  )
)


# ==============================================================
# 3. Helper: extract emmeans test statistic
# ==============================================================

species_house_icc_get_stat <- function(df) {

  if ("z.ratio" %in% names(df)) {

    return(
      as.numeric(
        df$z.ratio
      )
    )
  }

  if ("t.ratio" %in% names(df)) {

    return(
      as.numeric(
        df$t.ratio
      )
    )
  }

  rep(
    NA_real_,
    nrow(df)
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 4. Helper: House variance + ICC
#
# tolerance = 0 allows very small House variance estimates
# to be retained and reported.
#
# approximation = "lognormal" is used for these non-Gaussian
# models when estimating the distribution-specific variance.
# ==============================================================

species_house_icc_get_house_stats <- function(model) {

  vc <- glmmTMB::VarCorr(
    model
  )$cond

  house_variance <- as.numeric(
    vc$House[1, 1]
  )

  house_sd <- sqrt(
    house_variance
  )


  icc_result <- suppressWarnings(
    tryCatch(
      performance::icc(
        model,
        tolerance = 0,
        approximation = "lognormal"
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  )


  if (is.null(icc_result)) {

    icc_adjusted <- NA_real_
    icc_unadjusted <- NA_real_

  } else {

    icc_adjusted <- as.numeric(
      icc_result$ICC_adjusted[1]
    )

    icc_unadjusted <- as.numeric(
      icc_result$ICC_unadjusted[1]
    )
  }


  data.frame(
    Variance =
      house_variance,

    SD =
      house_sd,

    ICC_adjusted =
      icc_adjusted,

    ICC_unadjusted =
      icc_unadjusted,

    Percent_House_adjusted =
      icc_adjusted * 100,

    Percent_House_unadjusted =
      icc_unadjusted * 100
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 5. Helper: fit model with established species workflow
#
# Tweedie is attempted first because it preserves zeros.
#
# If Tweedie fails:
#   copies + 0.1
#   Gamma with log link
#
# House is NEVER removed.
# ==============================================================

species_house_icc_fit_model <- function(
  df,
  scope = c(
    "global",
    "growout"
  )
) {

  scope <- match.arg(
    scope
  )


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Global model
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  if (scope == "global") {

    tweedie_model <- tryCatch(

      glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
        copies_raw ~
          Treatment * Growout +
          Position +
          (1 | House),

        family = glmmTMB::tweedie(
          link = "log"
        ),

        data = df
      ),

      error = function(e) NULL
    )


    if (!is.null(tweedie_model)) {

      return(
        list(
          model =
            tweedie_model,

          family =
            "tweedie",

          response_adjustment =
            "none"
        )
      )
    }


    df$copies_adj <-
      df$copies_raw + 0.1


    gamma_model <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
      copies_adj ~
        Treatment * Growout +
        Position +
        (1 | House),

      family = stats::Gamma(
        link = "log"
      ),

      data = df
    )


    return(
      list(
        model =
          gamma_model,

        family =
          "gamma",

        response_adjustment =
          "+0.1"
      )
    )
  }


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Growout-specific model
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  tweedie_model <- tryCatch(

    glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
      copies_raw ~
        Treatment +
        Position +
        (1 | House),

      family = glmmTMB::tweedie(
        link = "log"
      ),

      data = df
    ),

    error = function(e) NULL
  )


  if (!is.null(tweedie_model)) {

    return(
      list(
        model =
          tweedie_model,

        family =
          "tweedie",

        response_adjustment =
          "none"
      )
    )
  }


  df$copies_adj <-
    df$copies_raw + 0.1


  gamma_model <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
    copies_adj ~
      Treatment +
      Position +
      (1 | House),

    family = stats::Gamma(
      link = "log"
    ),

    data = df
  )


  list(
    model =
      gamma_model,

    family =
      "gamma",

    response_adjustment =
      "+0.1"
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 6. Helper: fit ONE species
#
# For each species:
#   - one global model
#   - one model within Growout 1
#   - one model within Growout 2
#
# Only the GLOBAL model receives DHARMa simulations.
# ==============================================================

fit_one_species_house_icc <- function(
  target_species,
  n_sims = 1000
) {

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prepare species data
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  df <- entero_species_merged %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Target..Name. == target_species
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Growout =
        factor(Growout),

      Treatment =
        factor(Treatment),

      House =
        factor(House),

      Position =
        factor(Position),

      copies_raw =
        copies_per_g_litter
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      is.finite(copies_raw),
      copies_raw >= 0
    ) %>%
    droplevels()


  n_zero <- sum(
    df$copies_raw == 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  n_nonzero <- sum(
    df$copies_raw > 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )


  cat(
    "\n============================================================\n",
    "Species: ",
    target_species,
    "\n",
    "n = ",
    nrow(df),
    "\n",
    "Zeros = ",
    n_zero,
    "\n",
    "Non-zeros = ",
    n_nonzero,
    "\n",
    "============================================================\n",
    sep = ""
  )


  # ============================================================
  # GLOBAL MODEL
  # ============================================================

  global_fit <-
    species_house_icc_fit_model(
      df = df,
      scope = "global"
    )


  model_full <-
    global_fit$model

  family_name <-
    global_fit$family

  response_adjustment <-
    global_fit$response_adjustment


  cat(
    "Global family:",
    family_name,
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Global response adjustment:",
    response_adjustment,
    "\n"
  )


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Global Type III Wald tests
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  anova_result <- car::Anova(
    model_full,
    type = 3
  )


  cat(
    "\n--- Global Type III Wald Tests ---\n"
  )

  print(
    anova_result
  )


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Global Treatment contrast
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  global_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
    model_full,
    ~ Treatment
  )

  global_pairs <- emmeans::contrast(
    global_emm,
    method = "pairwise",
    adjust = "BH"
  )


  cat(
    "\n--- Global Treatment Effect ---\n"
  )

  print(
    summary(
      global_pairs
    )
  )


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Treatment contrasts within Growout
  #
  # IMPORTANT:
  # These are obtained from the GLOBAL model, as in the
  # original analysis and manuscript Methods.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  pergrowout_emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
    model_full,
    ~ Treatment | Growout
  )

  pergrowout_pairs <- emmeans::contrast(
    pergrowout_emm,
    method = "pairwise",
    adjust = "BH"
  )


  cat(
    "\n--- Treatment Effects Within Growout ---\n"
  )

  print(
    summary(
      pergrowout_pairs
    )
  )


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Global House variance + ICC
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  global_house <-
    species_house_icc_get_house_stats(
      model_full
    )


  cat(
    "\n--- Global House Variance / ICC ---\n"
  )

  print(
    global_house
  )


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # GLOBAL DHARMa only
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  set.seed(
    5080 +
      match(
        target_species,
        c(
          "Cecorum",
          "Hirae"
        )
      )
  )

  simres <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(
    fittedModel = model_full,
    n = n_sims
  )

  disp_test <- DHARMa::testDispersion(
    simres
  )

  out_test <- DHARMa::testOutliers(
    simres
  )

  quant_test <- DHARMa::testQuantiles(
    simres
  )


  cat(
    "\n--- Global DHARMa Diagnostics ---\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Dispersion p =",
    disp_test$p.value,
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Outliers p =",
    out_test$p.value,
    "\n"
  )

  cat(
    "Quantiles p =",
    quant_test$p.value,
    "\n"
  )


  # ============================================================
  # GROWOUT-SPECIFIC MODELS
  #
  # Same structure as original manuscript reporting:
  #
  #   copies ~ Treatment + Position + (1 | House)
  #
  # Difference:
  #   House is NEVER dropped.
  #
  # No additional DHARMa simulations are run here.
  # ============================================================

  pergo_models <- lapply(
    levels(df$Growout),
    function(growout_value) {

      df_i <- df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          as.character(Growout) ==
            as.character(growout_value)
        ) %>%
        droplevels()


      n_zero_i <- sum(
        df_i$copies_raw == 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

      n_nonzero_i <- sum(
        df_i$copies_raw > 0,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )


      fit_i <-
        species_house_icc_fit_model(
          df = df_i,
          scope = "growout"
        )


      model_i <-
        fit_i$model


      anova_i <- car::Anova(
        model_i,
        type = 3
      )


      house_i <-
        species_house_icc_get_house_stats(
          model_i
        )


      cat(
        "\n----------------------------------------------\n",
        target_species,
        " | Growout ",
        growout_value,
        "\n",
        "Family: ",
        fit_i$family,
        "\n",
        "Response adjustment: ",
        fit_i$response_adjustment,
        "\n",
        "----------------------------------------------\n",
        sep = ""
      )


      print(
        anova_i
      )


      cat(
        "\nHouse variance / ICC:\n"
      )

      print(
        house_i
      )


      list(
        Growout =
          as.character(growout_value),

        N =
          stats::nobs(model_i),

        Zeros =
          n_zero_i,

        Nonzeros =
          n_nonzero_i,

        Family =
          fit_i$family,

        Response_adjustment =
          fit_i$response_adjustment,

        model =
          model_i,

        anova =
          anova_i,

        house =
          house_i
      )
    }
  )


  names(pergo_models) <-
    levels(df$Growout)


  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Return one complete object for species
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  list(
    species =
      target_species,

    family =
      family_name,

    response_adjustment =
      response_adjustment,

    n =
      stats::nobs(model_full),

    n_zero =
      n_zero,

    n_nonzero =
      n_nonzero,

    model =
      model_full,

    anova =
      anova_result,

    global_pairs =
      global_pairs,

    pergrowout_pairs =
      pergrowout_pairs,

    global_house =
      global_house,

    dharma_sim =
      simres,

    dharma_dispersion =
      disp_test,

    dharma_outliers =
      out_test,

    dharma_quantiles =
      quant_test,

    pergo_models =
      pergo_models
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 7. Fit both species
# ==============================================================

species_house_icc_targets <- c(
  "Cecorum",
  "Hirae"
)


species_house_icc_models <- lapply(
  species_house_icc_targets,
  function(species_name) {

    fit_one_species_house_icc(
      target_species =
        species_name,

      n_sims =
        1000
    )
  }
)


names(species_house_icc_models) <-
  species_house_icc_targets


# ==============================================================
# 8. Helper: convert ONE species into flat result rows
# ==============================================================

species_house_icc_build_rows <- function(
  model_result
) {

  species_name <-
    model_result$species

  family_name <-
    model_result$family

  adjustment_name <-
    model_result$response_adjustment

  model_n <-
    model_result$n

  n_zero <-
    model_result$n_zero

  n_nonzero <-
    model_result$n_nonzero


  # ============================================================
  # A. GLOBAL Type III fixed effects
  # ============================================================

  anova_global <- as.data.frame(
    model_result$anova
  )

  anova_global$Effect <- rownames(
    anova_global
  )

  rownames(
    anova_global
  ) <- NULL


  anova_global <- anova_global[
    anova_global$Effect != "(Intercept)",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


  rows_global_fixed <- data.frame(

    Analysis =
      "Global",

    Species =
      species_name,

    Growout =
      "All",

    Family =
      family_name,

    Response_adjustment =
      adjustment_name,

    N =
      model_n,

    Zeros =
      n_zero,

    Nonzeros =
      n_nonzero,

    Result_type =
      "Fixed effect - Type III Wald",

    Effect_or_contrast =
      as.character(
        anova_global$Effect
      ),

    Estimate =
      NA_real_,

    SE =
      NA_real_,

    df =
      as.numeric(
        anova_global[, "Df"]
      ),

    Test_statistic =
      as.numeric(
        anova_global[, "Chisq"]
      ),

    P_value =
      as.numeric(
        anova_global[, "Pr(>Chisq)"]
      ),

    Variance =
      NA_real_,

    SD =
      NA_real_,

    ICC_adjusted =
      NA_real_,

    ICC_unadjusted =
      NA_real_,

    Percent_House_adjusted =
      NA_real_,

    Percent_House_unadjusted =
      NA_real_,

    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  )


  # ============================================================
  # B. GLOBAL Treatment contrast
  # ============================================================

  global_df <- as.data.frame(
    summary(
      model_result$global_pairs
    )
  )


  global_stat <-
    species_house_icc_get_stat(
      global_df
    )


  global_df_value <- if (
    "df" %in% names(global_df)
  ) {

    as.numeric(
      global_df$df
    )

  } else {

    rep(
      NA_real_,
      nrow(global_df)
    )
  }


  rows_global_pair <- data.frame(

    Analysis =
      "Global",

    Species =
      species_name,

    Growout =
      "All",

    Family =
      family_name,

    Response_adjustment =
      adjustment_name,

    N =
      model_n,

    Zeros =
      n_zero,

    Nonzeros =
      n_nonzero,

    Result_type =
      "Treatment contrast - global emmeans",

    Effect_or_contrast =
      as.character(
        global_df$contrast
      ),

    Estimate =
      as.numeric(
        global_df$estimate
      ),

    SE =
      as.numeric(
        global_df$SE
      ),

    df =
      global_df_value,

    Test_statistic =
      global_stat,

    P_value =
      as.numeric(
        global_df$p.value
      ),

    Variance =
      NA_real_,

    SD =
      NA_real_,

    ICC_adjusted =
      NA_real_,

    ICC_unadjusted =
      NA_real_,

    Percent_House_adjusted =
      NA_real_,

    Percent_House_unadjusted =
      NA_real_,

    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  )


  # ============================================================
  # C. Treatment contrasts within Growout
  #    FROM GLOBAL MODEL
  # ============================================================

  pergo_df <- as.data.frame(
    summary(
      model_result$pergrowout_pairs
    )
  )


  pergo_stat <-
    species_house_icc_get_stat(
      pergo_df
    )


  pergo_df_value <- if (
    "df" %in% names(pergo_df)
  ) {

    as.numeric(
      pergo_df$df
    )

  } else {

    rep(
      NA_real_,
      nrow(pergo_df)
    )
  }


  rows_pergo_pairs <- data.frame(

    Analysis =
      "Within-growout",

    Species =
      species_name,

    Growout =
      as.character(
        pergo_df$Growout
      ),

    Family =
      family_name,

    Response_adjustment =
      adjustment_name,

    N =
      model_n,

    Zeros =
      n_zero,

    Nonzeros =
      n_nonzero,

    Result_type =
      "Treatment contrast - emmeans",

    Effect_or_contrast =
      as.character(
        pergo_df$contrast
      ),

    Estimate =
      as.numeric(
        pergo_df$estimate
      ),

    SE =
      as.numeric(
        pergo_df$SE
      ),

    df =
      pergo_df_value,

    Test_statistic =
      pergo_stat,

    P_value =
      as.numeric(
        pergo_df$p.value
      ),

    Variance =
      NA_real_,

    SD =
      NA_real_,

    ICC_adjusted =
      NA_real_,

    ICC_unadjusted =
      NA_real_,

    Percent_House_adjusted =
      NA_real_,

    Percent_House_unadjusted =
      NA_real_,

    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  )


  # ============================================================
  # D. GLOBAL House random effect
  # ============================================================

  rows_global_house <- data.frame(

    Analysis =
      "Global",

    Species =
      species_name,

    Growout =
      "All",

    Family =
      family_name,

    Response_adjustment =
      adjustment_name,

    N =
      model_n,

    Zeros =
      n_zero,

    Nonzeros =
      n_nonzero,

    Result_type =
      "Random effect",

    Effect_or_contrast =
      "House",

    Estimate =
      NA_real_,

    SE =
      NA_real_,

    df =
      NA_real_,

    Test_statistic =
      NA_real_,

    P_value =
      NA_real_,

    Variance =
      model_result$global_house$Variance,

    SD =
      model_result$global_house$SD,

    ICC_adjusted =
      model_result$global_house$ICC_adjusted,

    ICC_unadjusted =
      model_result$global_house$ICC_unadjusted,

    Percent_House_adjusted =
      model_result$global_house$Percent_House_adjusted,

    Percent_House_unadjusted =
      model_result$global_house$Percent_House_unadjusted,

    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  )


  # ============================================================
  # E. GLOBAL DHARMa diagnostics
  # ============================================================

  rows_dharma <- data.frame(

    Analysis = rep(
      "Global",
      3
    ),

    Species = rep(
      species_name,
      3
    ),

    Growout = rep(
      "All",
      3
    ),

    Family = rep(
      family_name,
      3
    ),

    Response_adjustment = rep(
      adjustment_name,
      3
    ),

    N = rep(
      model_n,
      3
    ),

    Zeros = rep(
      n_zero,
      3
    ),

    Nonzeros = rep(
      n_nonzero,
      3
    ),

    Result_type = rep(
      "DHARMa diagnostic",
      3
    ),

    Effect_or_contrast = c(
      "Dispersion",
      "Outliers",
      "Quantiles"
    ),

    Estimate =
      NA_real_,

    SE =
      NA_real_,

    df =
      NA_real_,

    Test_statistic =
      NA_real_,

    P_value = c(
      model_result$dharma_dispersion$p.value,
      model_result$dharma_outliers$p.value,
      model_result$dharma_quantiles$p.value
    ),

    Variance =
      NA_real_,

    SD =
      NA_real_,

    ICC_adjusted =
      NA_real_,

    ICC_unadjusted =
      NA_real_,

    Percent_House_adjusted =
      NA_real_,

    Percent_House_unadjusted =
      NA_real_,

    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  )


  # ============================================================
  # F. GROWOUT-SPECIFIC Type III + House rows
  # ============================================================

  rows_pergo_models <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    lapply(
      names(
        model_result$pergo_models
      ),
      function(growout_value) {

        one <- getElement(
          model_result$pergo_models,
          growout_value
        )


        # --------------------------------------------------------
        # Type III Treatment + Position
        # --------------------------------------------------------

        anova_i <- as.data.frame(
          one$anova
        )

        anova_i$Effect <- rownames(
          anova_i
        )

        rownames(
          anova_i
        ) <- NULL


        anova_i <- anova_i[
          anova_i$Effect != "(Intercept)",
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]


        fixed_i <- data.frame(

          Analysis =
            "Growout-specific",

          Species =
            species_name,

          Growout =
            growout_value,

          Family =
            one$Family,

          Response_adjustment =
            one$Response_adjustment,

          N =
            one$N,

          Zeros =
            one$Zeros,

          Nonzeros =
            one$Nonzeros,

          Result_type =
            "Fixed effect - Type III Wald",

          Effect_or_contrast =
            as.character(
              anova_i$Effect
            ),

          Estimate =
            NA_real_,

          SE =
            NA_real_,

          df =
            as.numeric(
              anova_i[, "Df"]
            ),

          Test_statistic =
            as.numeric(
              anova_i[, "Chisq"]
            ),

          P_value =
            as.numeric(
              anova_i[, "Pr(>Chisq)"]
            ),

          Variance =
            NA_real_,

          SD =
            NA_real_,

          ICC_adjusted =
            NA_real_,

          ICC_unadjusted =
            NA_real_,

          Percent_House_adjusted =
            NA_real_,

          Percent_House_unadjusted =
            NA_real_,

          stringsAsFactors =
            FALSE
        )


        # --------------------------------------------------------
        # House variance + ICC
        # --------------------------------------------------------

        house_i <- data.frame(

          Analysis =
            "Growout-specific",

          Species =
            species_name,

          Growout =
            growout_value,

          Family =
            one$Family,

          Response_adjustment =
            one$Response_adjustment,

          N =
            one$N,

          Zeros =
            one$Zeros,

          Nonzeros =
            one$Nonzeros,

          Result_type =
            "Random effect",

          Effect_or_contrast =
            "House",

          Estimate =
            NA_real_,

          SE =
            NA_real_,

          df =
            NA_real_,

          Test_statistic =
            NA_real_,

          P_value =
            NA_real_,

          Variance =
            one$house$Variance,

          SD =
            one$house$SD,

          ICC_adjusted =
            one$house$ICC_adjusted,

          ICC_unadjusted =
            one$house$ICC_unadjusted,

          Percent_House_adjusted =
            one$house$Percent_House_adjusted,

          Percent_House_unadjusted =
            one$house$Percent_House_unadjusted,

          stringsAsFactors =
            FALSE
        )


        dplyr::bind_rows(
          fixed_i,
          house_i
        )
      }
    )
  )


  # ============================================================
  # G. Combine everything for species
  # ============================================================

  dplyr::bind_rows(
    rows_global_fixed,
    rows_global_pair,
    rows_global_house,
    rows_dharma,
    rows_pergo_models,
    rows_pergo_pairs
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 9. Convert BOTH species into ONE flat results table
# ==============================================================

species_house_icc_results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    species_house_icc_targets,
    function(species_name) {

      model_result <- getElement(
        species_house_icc_models,
        species_name
      )

      species_house_icc_build_rows(
        model_result
      )
    }
  )
)


# ==============================================================
# 10. Order results
# ==============================================================

species_house_icc_results <- species_house_icc_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Species_order = match(
      Species,
      c(
        "Cecorum",
        "Hirae"
      )
    ),

    Analysis_order =
      dplyr::case_when(
        Analysis == "Global" ~ 1,
        Analysis == "Growout-specific" ~ 2,
        Analysis == "Within-growout" ~ 3,
        TRUE ~ 4
      ),

    Growout_order =
      dplyr::case_when(
        Growout == "All" ~ 0,
        Growout == "1" ~ 1,
        Growout == "2" ~ 2,
        TRUE ~ 99
      ),

    Result_order =
      dplyr::case_when(

        Result_type ==
          "Fixed effect - Type III Wald" ~ 1,

        Result_type ==
          "Treatment contrast - global emmeans" ~ 2,

        Result_type ==
          "Treatment contrast - emmeans" ~ 3,

        Result_type ==
          "Random effect" ~ 4,

        Result_type ==
          "DHARMa diagnostic" ~ 5,

        TRUE ~ 99
      )
  ) %>%

  dplyr::arrange(
    Species_order,
    Analysis_order,
    Growout_order,
    Result_order
  ) %>%

  dplyr::select(
    -Species_order,
    -Analysis_order,
    -Growout_order,
    -Result_order
  )


# ==============================================================
# 11. Confirm no list-columns
# ==============================================================

species_house_icc_list_check <- vapply(

)

species_house_icc_list_columns <- names(

)[species_house_icc_list_check]


if (

) {
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================
# UPDATED COMBINED ENTEROCOCCUS VISUALIZATION
# Genus + species dPCR
#
# Statistical annotations now come from models that retain:

#

# New objects are created so previous plotting objects are not

library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)
library(grid)


# ==============================================================
# Helper function to format p-values for plotmath
# ==============================================================

fmt_p_parse_entero_house <- function(p) {

  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("italic(p)==NA")
  }

  if (p < 1e-3) {
    return(
      sprintf(
        "italic(p)==%s",
        formatC(
          p,
          format = "e",
          digits = 3
        )
      )
    )
  }

  return(
    sprintf(
      "italic(p)==%.3f",
      p
    )
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# PART 1
# Combined dPCR plotting data
# ==============================================================


# ==============================================================
# 1. Genus-level dPCR data
# ==============================================================

genus_data_house_icc <- entero.merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = "Enterococcus",
    copies_per_g_litter = copies_per_gram,
    log10_copies = log10(copies_per_gram),
    Sample.NTC.Control = as.character(
      Sample.NTC.Control
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Sample.NTC.Control,
    Growout,
    Treatment,
    House,
    Position,
    copies_per_g_litter,
    log10_copies,
    Target
  )


# ==============================================================
# 2. Species-level dPCR data
# ==============================================================

species_data_house_icc <- entero_species_merged %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = paste(
      "E.",
      tolower(Target..Name.)
    ),
    log10_copies = log10(
      copies_per_g_litter
    ),
    Sample.NTC.Control = as.character(
      Sample.NTC.Control
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Sample.NTC.Control,
    Growout,
    Treatment,
    House,
    Position,
    copies_per_g_litter,
    log10_copies,
    Target
  )


# ==============================================================
# 3. Combine dPCR plotting data
# ==============================================================

entero_combined_plot_house_icc <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  genus_data_house_icc,
  species_data_house_icc
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Growout = as.character(
      Growout
    ),

    Treatment = factor(
      ifelse(
        Treatment == "IndigoLT",
        "Alternative",
        as.character(Treatment)
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Control",
        "Alternative"
      )
    ),

    Target = factor(
      Target,
      levels = c(
        "Enterococcus",
        "E. cecorum",
        "E. hirae"
      )
    )
  )


cat(
  "Combined dPCR plotting data:",
  nrow(entero_combined_plot_house_icc),
  "rows\n"
)

cat(
  "Targets:",
  levels(entero_combined_plot_house_icc$Target),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Treatments:",
  levels(entero_combined_plot_house_icc$Treatment),
  "\n"
)


# ==============================================================
# 4. Extract updated genus dPCR p-values
#
# Source:
#   revised genus model with House retained
# ==============================================================

genus_pairs_house_icc <- entero_genus_icc_pergo_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    as.character(Growout) %in% c(
      "1",
      "2"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    grepl(
      "Control\\s*-\\s*IndigoLT|IndigoLT\\s*-\\s*Control",
      contrast
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Target = "Enterococcus",
    Growout = as.character(
      Growout
    ),
    P_Value = as.numeric(
      p.value
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Target,
    Growout,
    P_Value
  )


# ==============================================================
# 5. Extract updated species dPCR p-values
#
# Source:
#   revised species models with House retained
# ==============================================================

species_pairs_house_icc <- species_house_icc_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Analysis == "Within-growout",
    Result_type == "Treatment contrast - emmeans",
    Growout %in% c(
      "1",
      "2"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    grepl(
      "Control\\s*-\\s*IndigoLT|IndigoLT\\s*-\\s*Control",
      Effect_or_contrast
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Target = dplyr::case_when(
      Species == "Cecorum" ~ "E. cecorum",
      Species == "Hirae" ~ "E. hirae",
      TRUE ~ Species
    ),

    Growout = as.character(
      Growout
    ),

    P_Value = as.numeric(
      P_value
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Target,
    Growout,
    P_Value
  )


# ==============================================================
# 6. Combine updated dPCR p-values
# ==============================================================

entero_pairs_df_house_icc <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  genus_pairs_house_icc,
  species_pairs_house_icc
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Target = factor(
      Target,
      levels = c(
        "Enterococcus",
        "E. cecorum",
        "E. hirae"
      )
    ),

    Growout = as.character(
      Growout
    ),

    P_Label = vapply(
      P_Value,
      fmt_p_parse_entero_house,
      character(1)
    )
  )


cat(
  "\n==============================================\n",
  "UPDATED dPCR P-VALUES USED IN FIGURE\n",
  "==============================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  entero_pairs_df_house_icc
)


# ==============================================================
# 7. Calculate annotation positions
# ==============================================================

p_ypos_entero_house_icc <- entero_combined_plot_house_icc %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    Target,
    Growout
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    y_pos = max(
      log10_copies,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) * 1.02,
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# ==============================================================
# 8. Join updated p-values to annotation positions
# ==============================================================

entero_pairs_annot_house_icc <- dplyr::left_join(
  entero_pairs_df_house_icc,
  p_ypos_entero_house_icc,
  by = c(
    "Target",
    "Growout"
  )
)


# ==============================================================
# 9. Updated combined dPCR-only plot
# ==============================================================

entero_combined_boxplot_house_icc <- ggplot(

# ==============================================================
# PART 2
# COMBINED ENTEROCOCCUS 16S + dPCR VISUALIZATION
#
# dPCR annotations now use the updated House-retained models.

# CSS counts:

# ==============================================================
# 11. Treatment-label helper
# ==============================================================

clean_treatment_entero_house <- function(x) {

  dplyr::recode(
    as.character(x),
    "IndigoLT" = "Alternative"
  )
}


# ==============================================================
# 12. Genus-level Enterococcus CSS counts
# ==============================================================

entero_genus_css_house_icc <- phyloseq::psmelt(
  phy_genus
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Genus == "Enterococcus"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Treatment = factor(
      clean_treatment_entero_house(
        Treatment
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Control",
        "Alternative"
      )
    ),

    Growout = factor(
      Growout
    ),

    Target =
      "italic('Enterococcus')",

    Measure =
      "log[10]~CSS~counts~'(16S)'",

    value = log10(
      Abundance + 1
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Sample,
    Growout,
    Treatment,
    Target,
    Measure,
    value
  )


# ==============================================================
# 13. Genus-level Enterococcus relative abundance
# ==============================================================

phy_genus_rel_house_icc <-
  phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(
    phy_genus,
    function(x) {
      x / sum(x)
    }
  )


entero_genus_ra_house_icc <- phyloseq::psmelt(
  phy_genus_rel_house_icc
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Genus == "Enterococcus"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Treatment = factor(
      clean_treatment_entero_house(
        Treatment
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Control",
        "Alternative"
      )
    ),

    Growout = factor(
      Growout
    ),

    Target =
      "italic('Enterococcus')",

    Measure =
      "'%'~relative~abundance~'(16S)'",

    value =
      Abundance * 100
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Sample,
    Growout,
    Treatment,
    Target,
    Measure,
    value
  )


# ==============================================================
# 14. Species-level CSS counts
# ==============================================================

species_css_long_house_icc <- phyloseq::psmelt(
  physeq_no_growout3_css
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Genus == "Enterococcus"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Species_clean = tolower(
      gsub(
        "^Enterococcus\\s+",
        "",
        Species
      )
    ),

    Target = dplyr::case_when(

      Species_clean %in% c(
        "cecorum",
        "e. cecorum",
        "enterococcus cecorum"
      ) ~
        "italic('E. cecorum')",

      Species_clean %in% c(
        "hirae",
        "e. hirae",
        "enterococcus hirae"
      ) ~
        "italic('E. hirae')",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%

  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Target)
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Treatment = factor(
      clean_treatment_entero_house(
        Treatment
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Control",
        "Alternative"
      )
    ),

    Growout = factor(
      Growout
    ),

    Measure =
      "log[10]~CSS~counts~'(16S)'",

    value = log10(
      Abundance + 1
    )
  ) %>%

  dplyr::select(
    Sample,
    Growout,
    Treatment,
    Target,
    Measure,
    value
  )


# ==============================================================
# 15. Species-level relative abundance
# ==============================================================

phy_species_rel_house_icc <-
  phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(
    physeq_no_growout3_css,
    function(x) {
      x / sum(x)
    }
  )


species_ra_long_house_icc <- phyloseq::psmelt(
  phy_species_rel_house_icc
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Genus == "Enterococcus"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Species_clean = tolower(
      gsub(
        "^Enterococcus\\s+",
        "",
        Species
      )
    ),

    Target = dplyr::case_when(

      Species_clean %in% c(
        "cecorum",
        "e. cecorum",
        "enterococcus cecorum"
      ) ~
        "italic('E. cecorum')",

      Species_clean %in% c(
        "hirae",
        "e. hirae",
        "enterococcus hirae"
      ) ~
        "italic('E. hirae')",

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%

  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Target)
  ) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Treatment = factor(
      clean_treatment_entero_house(
        Treatment
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Control",
        "Alternative"
      )
    ),

    Growout = factor(
      Growout
    ),

    Measure =
      "'%'~relative~abundance~'(16S)'",

    value =
      Abundance * 100
  ) %>%

  dplyr::select(
    Sample,
    Growout,
    Treatment,
    Target,
    Measure,
    value
  )


# ==============================================================
# 16. dPCR data
#
# Uses updated combined dPCR plotting object.
# ==============================================================

dpcr_long_house_icc <- entero_combined_plot_house_icc %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Treatment = factor(
      clean_treatment_entero_house(
        Treatment
      ),
      levels = c(
        "Control",
        "Alternative"
      )
    ),

    Growout = factor(
      Growout
    ),

    Target = dplyr::case_when(

      Target %in% c(
        "Enterococcus",
        "Genus",
        "Total Enterococcus"
      ) ~
        "italic('Enterococcus')",

      Target %in% c(
        "Cecorum",
        "E. cecorum",
        "Enterococcus cecorum"
      ) ~
        "italic('E. cecorum')",

      Target %in% c(
        "Hirae",
        "E. hirae",
        "Enterococcus hirae"
      ) ~
        "italic('E. hirae')",

      TRUE ~
        as.character(Target)
    ),

    Measure =
      "log[10]~counts~'(dPCR)'",

    value =
      log10_copies
  ) %>%

  dplyr::select(
    Growout,
    Treatment,
    Target,
    Measure,
    value
  )


# ==============================================================
# 17. Combine all 16S + dPCR plotting data
# ==============================================================

entero_all_plot_house_icc <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  entero_genus_css_house_icc,
  species_css_long_house_icc,
  entero_genus_ra_house_icc,
  species_ra_long_house_icc,
  dpcr_long_house_icc
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

    Target = factor(
      Target,
      levels = c(
        "italic('Enterococcus')",
        "italic('E. cecorum')",
        "italic('E. hirae')"
      )
    ),

    Measure = factor(
      Measure,
      levels = c(
        "log[10]~CSS~counts~'(16S)'",
        "'%'~relative~abundance~'(16S)'",
        "log[10]~counts~'(dPCR)'"
      )
    )
  )


# ==============================================================
# 18. Prepare UPDATED dPCR-only statistical annotations
# ==============================================================

entero_pairs_annot_combined_house_icc <-
  entero_pairs_annot_house_icc %>%

  dplyr::mutate(

    Growout = factor(
      Growout
    ),

    Target = dplyr::case_when(

      Target %in% c(
        "Enterococcus",
        "Genus",
        "Total Enterococcus"
      ) ~
        "italic('Enterococcus')",

      Target %in% c(
        "Cecorum",
        "E. cecorum",
        "Enterococcus cecorum"
      ) ~
        "italic('E. cecorum')",

      Target %in% c(
        "Hirae",
        "E. hirae",
        "Enterococcus hirae"
      ) ~
        "italic('E. hirae')",

      TRUE ~
        as.character(Target)
    ),

    Target = factor(
      Target,
      levels = c(
        "italic('Enterococcus')",
        "italic('E. cecorum')",
        "italic('E. hirae')"
      )
    ),

    Measure = factor(
      "log[10]~counts~'(dPCR)'",
      levels = c(
        "log[10]~CSS~counts~'(16S)'",
        "'%'~relative~abundance~'(16S)'",
        "log[10]~counts~'(dPCR)'"
      )
    )
  )


# ==============================================================
# 19. Combined 16S + dPCR plot
# ==============================================================

entero_16s_dpcr_boxplot_house_icc <- ggplot(
  entero_all_plot_house_icc,
  aes(
    x = Growout,
    y = value
  )
) +

  geom_boxplot(
    aes(
      fill = Treatment
    ),
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.9,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    position = position_dodge(
      width = 0.9
    )
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    aes(
      fill = Treatment
    ),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 23,
    size = 3,
    color = "white",
    position = position_dodge(
      width = 0.9
    ),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_jitter(
    aes(
      color = Treatment
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.25,
    alpha = 0.9,
    fill = "white",
    position = position_jitterdodge(
      jitter.width = 0.1,
      dodge.width = 0.9
    ),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data =
      entero_pairs_annot_combined_house_icc,
    aes(
      x = Growout,
      y = y_pos,
      label = P_Label
    ),
    parse = TRUE,
    size = 3,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 0
  ) +

  ggh4x::facet_grid2(
    rows = vars(
      Measure
    ),
    cols = vars(
      Target
    ),
    scales = "free",
    independent = "y",
    labeller = labeller(
      Measure = label_parsed,
      Target = label_parsed
    )
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Control" = "#f8765c",
      "Alternative" = "#221150"
    )
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Control" = "black",
      "Alternative" = "black"
    )
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(
        0.05,
        0.15
      )
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    fill = "Treatment",
    x = "Growout",
    y = NULL
  ) +

  theme_bw() +

  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 14
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 14
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 12,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(
      size = 12
    ),
    strip.text.y = element_text(
      size = 9
    ),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 14
    ),
    legend.position = "top"
  )


# ==============================================================
# 20. Display updated combined figure
# ==============================================================

print(
  entero_16s_dpcr_boxplot_house_icc
)


# ==============================================================
# 21. Save updated combined figure
# ==============================================================

ggsave(
  filename =
    "entero_16s_dpcr_boxplot_house_retained.png",
  plot =
    entero_16s_dpcr_boxplot_house_icc,
  width = 6,
  height = 6.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 900
)
```
